formEditorRoundtrip.method: 4D Form Editor: move the Name object one pixel right then left, save, compare definitions and reinstall

changes: A methods-only install does not parse application forms.
A Null central configuration result uses automatic defaults. Parent narrowed fallback to Null so malformed non-object options remain rejected.
minimalHostChanges.validation: Post-review interpreted/compiled configuration, generated/shared-data/modal, discovery and entity recovery suites.

notes: The new native area, button dispatch and duplicate-name editor fixes were exercised in interpreted/compiled desktop runs. Compiler reports target ARM and Intel; Intel runtime is not claimed.
Initial runs exposed area string ownership, null diagnostics and nested-modal button-delivery defects; the production corrections passed the retained suites.
Fixture fixes await actual asynchronous startup, confirmed focus and final editor receipts; they never replay a mutating action. Root replacement observation now reads one tree per poll.
Interpreted 4D normalizes the synthetic entity catalog on close. A fresh fixture was compiled before the compiled entity run; source hash guards remain strict.

AreaList runs use a separately cached 11.4.2 vendor bundle and existing protected license. A missing cache and a controls-driver mismatch were corrected without changing application or vendor behavior.

Fable changed only helper-install preflight and Null-configuration defaults. The post-review suites exercise the changed paths and existing adapters; earlier grid runs retain their original source/report hashes.
The repository source check now honors Git ignore rules, so local licensed fixtures are excluded while tracked and new source files are checked.
limits: Existing unsupported control families and the AreaList supplementary-Unicode vendor restriction are unchanged. See STATUS.md.
A startup failure before context creation does not adopt a later manual start. That start needs manual stop; reopen the form for automatic startup.
Client/server delivery, Intel hardware, Windows, Voice Control and Switch Control are not established by these runs.
Local artifacts are ad hoc signed and unpublished. This is no claim about a signed downloadable 0.20.0 release or an application-specific integration.
